formDescription: General-information branch step. Collects the applicant's name and, for general requests, an optional certification that the applicant represents an Indigenous Governing Entity (IGE), which is exempt from application fees.

middle_name.title: Middle name
middle_name.description: Applicant's legal middle name, if any.

business_name.title: Business/Organization name
business_name.description: If applicable, the business or organization the applicant represents. Law firms should identify whether they represent the client in this request or someone else, and include a file number where possible.

ige_certification.title: I certify that I am a representative of, and authorized to make a request on behalf of, an Indigenous Governing Entity.
ige_certification.description: Only shown for general (non-personal) requests. An Indigenous Governing Entity is not required to pay application fees. Checking this exempts the request from the payment step.

ige_name.title: Name of Indigenous Governing Entity
ige_name.description: Required only when the IGE certification checkbox above is checked.
